free_tier.stated: No free tier. 荷兰NAT is CNY 1.00 a month: 256 MB RAM, 1.5 GB disk, 10 IPv4 ports plus 1 dedicated IPv6, 500 Mbit unlimited traffic on fair use, Linux, in the Netherlands. The cart page prints 库存 (stock) 5 beside it.

retention.stated: refunds rather than retention are documented: the vendor's pre-purchase note says products at CNY 5 and above support a 24-hour refund and others can 'self-refund' to account balance within 24 hours, and that if a product fails the remaining value is returned to balance. No deletion window for an unpaid service is stated

egress.terms: 500 Mbit, unlimited traffic on fair use ('500M不限流量(合理使用)'). The vendor states that if a server runs past its traffic allowance the term is extended to compensate rather than the box being cut off: '部分服务器流量有限，若流量超额，会补偿时长至流量恢复。'

interface_detail: Root in an LXC container over SSH, reachable on one of the 10 assigned IPv4 ports or directly on the dedicated IPv6 address. OS images offered are Linux only: Debian 13 and Alpine 3.23 are the two named on the configuration page.
tooling: any SSH client. The panel is a Chinese IDC billing system; no API is documented. The vendor states LXC containers may not themselves run Docker, because LXC and Docker are the same class of virtualization.
chaining: USD 0.150 a month, the lowest price found by a wide margin, for 256 MB and 1.5 GB with a dedicated IPv6 and 10 IPv4 ports at this price it is a throwaway probe, a DNS resolver or a second tunnel endpoint, and the vendor itself calls the products 'toys'.

limits.value: 10 IPv4 ports on a shared address plus 1 dedicated IPv6 address with all ports
256 MB RAM and 1.5 GB disk, the smallest shape LXC, so no custom kernel and no nested Docker
outbound port 25 is blocked, and outbound 80/443 to China is blocked; on IPv4 only, with the vendor stating '以上仅屏蔽IPv4，IPv6目前无任何屏蔽' (the above blocks IPv4 only; IPv6 currently has no blocks)

binding_note: 256 MB of RAM and 1.5 GB of disk bind long before the price or the traffic does; this is a single small service per box, not a host.

identity_cost.detail: no card at registration. The register page asks for an email address, a verification code sent to that email, a password and a password confirmation, plus a privacy checkbox - the inputs are name='email', name='code', name='password', name='checkPassword'. No card, address, phone or ID field is on the form. Payment rails were not read: the checkout is behind the account and no payment list appears on the cart or product-configuration pages. No card hold or authorisation amount is stated anywhere read.

reliability_note: The vendor publishes a status probe at status.jjfly.cloud and states in its own pre-purchase note that the products are cheap and positioned as toys ('定位为玩具属性'), that no China-mainland direct connectivity is guaranteed, and that data should be backed up. No reliability event was observed.
confidence_note: the CNY 1.00 monthly price, the shape, the 10 ports plus dedicated IPv6, the stock count of 5 and the OS list are quoted from the vendor's own cart and product-configuration pages read today. The registration fields are read from the vendor's own register page markup. The firewall rules and the fair-use compensation sentence are quoted from the vendor's own pre-purchase knowledge-base article.

notes: The blocks are stated as IPv4-only, and the dedicated IPv6 address is described as carrying no blocks at all, which makes the IPv6 side strictly more capable than the IPv4 side here. The vendor publishes test addresses for both families, which is a useful first-party signal that the IPv6 is real rather than nominal. Not established: the payment rails (the checkout needs an account), the exact overage behaviour (the vendor says it compensates with time rather than cutting off), and whether the 10 ports are assigned or chosen. The storefront is at idc.jjfly.cloud, a different host from the jjfly.cloud marketing site.

extras.price_arithmetic: CNY 1.00 a month, billed monthly; 1.00 / 6.684864 = USD 0.1496, rounded to USD 0.150. Rate: 1 USD = CNY 6.684864 (open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD, time_last_update_utc Sat, 24 Oct 2026 00:02:31 +0000). A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so 24/7 and 10 h/day are the same.
extras.renewal_usd: same CNY 1.00 a month; no promotional price and no end date printed
extras.stock: in stock: the cart page prints '库存：5' (stock: 5) beside 荷兰NAT, read 2026-10-24

network_out.ports: 10 IPv4 ports on a shared address, plus a dedicated IPv6 address with all ports
network_out.ipv6_prefix: one dedicated address, prefix not stated

nat_config.ports_assigned_or_chosen: not stated on any page read; the product page prints '10个IPv4端口+1个独立IPv6' and no mapping procedure. The dedicated IPv6 address is separate and unfiltered, so the port count is not the only route in.
